name: Organization Identifier
description: Credential that uniquely identifies a legal entity within the IDunion ecosystem.
summary: Credential type template for urn:idunion.org:oid:1, the legal-person identifier credential of the IDunion ecosystem. Format sd_jwt_vc, no PDF twin. A single Organization group holds organizationName, organizationIdentifier, registeredCountry, tradeName and registrationDate. Issued by the IDTL Organization ID Issuer and the NOOP Identity Authority wallet templates, both directly and through a CredentialRequirements issuer gated on a presented passport.
